goal:
Add token-based auth + API key management to Zo Sentinel (Phase 2).

BACKEND (ui_server.py):
1. Auth middleware: check Authorization: Bearer <token> header on all /api/* routes
   - Query auth_tokens WHERE token_id=<token> AND used=false AND expires_at > now()
   - If missing/invalid: return 401 {error: unauthorized}
   - Public routes (no auth): /health, /app/*, /api/submissions (POST only)

2. New routes:
   POST /api/auth/token: generate new token
     Body: {action, mcp_name?, admin_email, scope: admin|analyst|viewer}
     Returns: {token_id, expires_at, scope}
   GET /api/auth/tokens: list all active tokens (admin only)
   DELETE /api/auth/tokens/{token_id}: revoke token (admin only)

3. auth_tokens table (already exists):
   token_id(PK), action, mcp_name, submission_id, admin_email, expires_at, used, used_at
   Add column: scope VARCHAR DEFAULT analyst
   Add column: created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT now()

FRONTEND (ui_react/src/pages/Settings.tsx):
- API Keys section: list tokens, generate new, revoke
- Token display: show once on creation, then masked
- Scope selector: admin / analyst / viewer
- Expiry: 30d / 90d / never

AUTH FLOW:
- First visit: show setup wizard to generate admin token
- Store token in localStorage (warn: for dev only)
- All fetch() calls in zo-bridge.ts include Authorization header
constraints: auth_tokens table already exists -- do not recreate
